none: PAS BUC-43255A: Greek and Roman provincial coin: bronze coin (denomination B) of Antiochus IV
contea di ritrovamento: Buckinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A bronze coin (denomination B) of Antiochus IV dating to the period 169 to 168BC. There is considerable debate as to whether these were struck in Egypt or Syria. Obverse: Radiate, diademed head of Antiochus IV right. Reverse: Eagle standing right on thunderbolt. Reverse legend: BASILEVS ANTIOCHOS in two lines on right; THEOS EPIPHANOES in two lines on right (transliteration from Ancient Greek).…
